The only way to get structural information is to retrieve the 13C NMR spectrum for the sample, which will show signals in the aromatic region (≈110‑160 ppm). By counting the distinct aromatic carbon signals (considering symmetry), we can infer the number of aromatic carbons. We'll first request the 13C NMR spectrum.</thought>
